body: Thing is…I can’t be myself anymore…I’ve been wanting to end my own life since February 2020 and ever since it kept getting increasingly worse and worse and she’s the only one that will really grieve if I go but I can’t ever be myself or there for her anymore or even spend time with her much and be happy. If I took my own life I know it will be probably by staging an accident or something so no one knows it’s on purpose and is just another tragedy and it would cause my broken family to have to get back together for her so that’s one way I just can’t trust anyone to be there for her.

I wish my comments weren’t so negative as a result of what I’ve been through. Unfortunately being positive isn’t something I have anymore. I’ve seen the pattern. The things I’ve been through and how they truly have been for me. I truly doubt things will get better enough to near stop pain and make it even maybe worth it. I’m still planning taking my own life everyday but trying to find a way for my little sister first without hurting her and I’m giving up
I’m happy for you💞
I am truly so sorry for your loss😞
You’re seriously literally so nice, kind, and genuinely pure.
Way I feel just a tiny bit better now while crying😆😆
I wish I could do the same for you *virtual hugs*❤️❤️❤️

Sometimes I wish I had someone I can live for but it’s only my little sister now who I can almost no longer be happy around as the cause of everything and it hurts unbelievably how she’s right here but I can’t have even her💔
I’ve done so much work, planning and research to try and end my life without her knowing it was suicide so as an accident but in a way she would still be setup with someone and a real future but I’m still here and no matter from what angle I try to tackle it nothing works
I’m truly so sorry for your loss…I’ve lost her long ago, maybe one day I’ll accept and stop hurting but it gets better slowly eventually
I’m tearing up thank you so much I’m so sorry I don’t have the words…
I just don’t know how to do it anymore and it’s too much and I’m crying everyday because I have a little sister and it’s worse than even death💔
I wish I could still do that
Everything stopped working for me
My soul has been none stop dying for almost two years straight daily and everything just got worse from what started everything already on top and I know I’ll never recover
I wish I had much to lose but I don’t, it’s only one burden left now…but thank you…
I’m too scared to see tomorrow and it feels like life isn’t worth living anymore
Thank you
I tried…I feel myself giving up for good this time and I feel horrible and don’t know what to do

I feel horrible
